Using `json_schema_extra` works as expected:
```py
from typing import Annotated
from fastapi import FastAPI, UploadFile, Form, File

# Run using uvicorn main:app --reload
# Visit: http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs

app = FastAPI()


@app.post("/form-test")
async def form_test(
    str_data: Annotated[str, Form(json_schema_extra={"example": "test"})],
    file: Annotated[UploadFile, File()],
):
    return
```

But using only `Form(example=...)` doesn't.
@Kludex Alias in `File(alias="someAlias")` doesn't seem to work either, just ran into this in my codebase 🤔

> @Kludex Alias in `File(alias="someAlias")` doesn't seem to work either, just ran into this in my codebase 🤔

- https://github.com/tiangolo/fastapi/issues/10286
Seems like currently you can specify `json_schema_extra={"alias": alias}` as a workaround

If you use Forms the way you first did, it will end up in the **extra part of arguments, kwargs basically. But it is also stated in the code that this option is deprecated and also recommends to use json_schema_extra instead.
![Screenshot from 2024-04-19 20-52-45](https://github.com/tiangolo/fastapi/assets/127698173/23d9e378-df3b-4e2c-9ec0-4505ea3bcac5)

what you found might be an error because of that, so just stick to the recommended :)
if you want to see more about it, just go to the file `param_functions.py`

As stated in the swagger.io documentation, the examples field should be a list of dict containing a key name and a value. Currently it is rendered as list of values in the openapi.json file source: https://swagger.io/docs/specification/adding-examples/

Yeah, a little frustrating. [This](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/65504438/how-to-add-both-file-and-json-body-in-a-fastapi-post-request/70640522#70640522) has been the [case](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/71650452/use-fastapi-to-parse-incoming-post-request-from-slack/71650857#71650857) for quite some time.

For me the best workaround is doing the `json_schema_extra` suggested above. Thanks!
Hi, I’d like to work on this issue. Can someone guide me on how to get started?

> But using only `Form(example=...)` doesn't.

I think I'm confirming the same thing, but just `Form(examples=["HELLO"])` without having to specify it via `json_schema_extra={"example": "test"}` seems to work for me (it shows the example value only after clicking "Try it out"

I did try passing `Form(openapi_examples={...})` but never got it to show up in the openapi json schema file, so I'm wondering if there's some funny business going on there.

In the first example, trying it out shows up in Swagger UI: --- The example is indeed included in OpenAPI, so showing (or not showing) the examples would be an issue in Swagger UI, not really here. But this is all related to the difference between OpenAPI's `example` vs JSON Schema `examples` vs OpenAPI 3.1.0 support for JSON Schema's `examples`. All the details are explained here: https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/tutorial/schema-extra-example/#technical-details I'll now close this one. ☕
